presentation.label: Ear pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about your ear pain.  You may want to tell us when it started, which side it is affecting, whether you have had other symptoms like a cold, and whether there is hearing loss or discharge
pre_form_information: Many ear infections can be dealt with by the pharmacy

questions.question: Have you had a fever with this ear pain?
Have you noticed any discharge coming from the ear?
Have you experienced any hearing loss in the affected ear?
